post_trial_noop_command: wsl.exe -d Ubuntu -e bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail; printf diagnostic-noop=ok; exit 0'
interpretation: The WSL host wrapper reports exit 1 even for a no-op bash exit 0. Preserve both statuses; use the inner timeout/test status and raw unittest output for test disposition, while recording the outer wrapper as unreliable.
